title: The Tropical Moduli Space of Degree-3 Rational Maps
summary: We study tropical rational functions on the tropical projective line with three zeros and three poles in the torus, counted with multiplicity, modulo target automorphisms. The principal divisor identifies their moduli space with unordered pairs of disjoint effective divisors of degree three. We classify its \(53\) cells and prove that it is six-dimensional with ten contractible connected components.
